## Summary

Adopts the gamma spec drift in #59: upstream's `closed` filter is now `true`, `false` or `any` on `/events`, `/events/keyset`, `/markets` and `/markets/keyset`. The nightly's diff fingerprint still matched when I curled the spec, so upstream had not moved. Probed live on 2026-10-18 and recorded in `docs/specs/gamma/OBSERVED.md`.

- **Spec:** `docs/specs/gamma/openapi.yaml` re-synced.
- **API (additive):** `gamma::types::ClosedFilter` (`Open`, `Closed`, `Any`) and a `closed_filter` setter on `ListEvents`, `ListKeysetEvents`, `ListMarkets` and `ListKeysetMarkets`. `closed(bool)` is unchanged. The two markets routes answer `422` for `any` without an identifier filter; the events routes take it bare.
- **Behaviour change (DRIFT R13):** `Markets::get_many` and the CLOB's `event_group` send `closed=any` instead of `closed=true` + `closed=false`. `get_many` sends one request per 100 distinct ids, each with a `limit`, in turn.

## Defects found on the way (both pre-existing)

- An identifier filter holds at most 100 values. The `id` setters and `get_many` documented 400, and a longer list was a `422` on both legs.
- `/markets` returns **20 rows when no `limit` is sent**, even for an id lookup, so each leg of the old `get_many` silently lost every row past the 20th. The new live chunking test found it: 200 ids asked for, 41 back.
- A repeated `closed` is not last-wins, as `OBSERVED.md` said (`any` beats a bool, `false` beats `true`, either order). Corrected there.

## Review notes

- `get_many_fans_out_closed_true_and_false` is a v0.40.0 test, held by `test_body_diff.py` (AD-12). It keeps its name and now asserts the fan-out is gone, under a `[[drift]]` entry naming the new **DRIFT R13** row in `divergences.md`. `test_test_body_diff.py` pins the row set and gains R13. Every other edited test is newer than v0.40.0, or a new item (`CLOSED_FILTER_CASES` sits beside `CASES` for the same reason).
- Results of `get_many` are in the host's order within each chunk, not closed markets first. Noted in `docs/s3-migration.md` for the CHANGELOG.
- Not done: the CLI's `--status` and Python's `closed=` do not expose `any`.

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p polyoxide-polymarket --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- [x] `cargo check` for `gamma`, `gamma,specta` and `clob,gamma`; `cargo doc --workspace --all-features` with `-D warnings`
- [x] `cargo test -p polyoxide-polymarket --all-features`, `-p polyoxide -p polyoxide-cli --all-features`
- [x] `scripts/live_unwraps.py`, `scripts/test_body_diff.py --baseline v0.40.0`, `.github/scripts` pytest (without the dependency-allowlist and venue-gate tests; no dependencies changed)
- [x] Live (`--ignored`): the four new `closed=any` / chunking tests and `live_get_many_returns_both_open_and_closed`
- [ ] CI green, then close #59 with a comment linking the run (`Refs`, not `Closes`, so nothing closes before CI)
